content:
The test image shows very young corn seedlings (V1-V3 stage) in a field row. Key observations:
- Young seedlings with dark/blackened stem bases at soil line
- The center plant has a clearly darkened/rotted base
- Plants appear uneven in growth/health
- Dry cracked soil, early season field conditions

The Bacterial_stalk_rot reference shows collapse of mature plants — not matching these very young seedlings. The dark basal rotting pattern on young seedlings with dark crowns is characteristic of Fusarium crown/root/seedling rot.
